svg.title: Talk Before You Enforce
svg.desc: Sketch from above: five mannequins stand in a ring around a round rug, which is hatched, with small arcs of speech coming from them toward its middle. Away to the front right, a fence panel lies flat on the ground, unused. The people are the group sharing a system, from the pattern's context, with problems to deal with. The rug is the solution, the focus: a place set aside for the group to talk, such as a chat channel or a regular check-in. The speech arcs are a problem being raised there first, in front of everyone, instead of decided by an admin alone. The fence panel is technical enforcement, such as quotas, permissions, and bans: set aside, not built, and still there if the group chooses to use it later. The metaphor: a meeting ground everyone stands around as equals, where talking comes before fencing anyone in.
